metrics.case_accuracy: Each answerable case requires the exact fact requested; dates and amounts must match the canonical value. No fuzzy or post-run tolerance changes.
metrics.citation_accuracy: Every answerable result must cite the gold document and page with an exact supporting excerpt. For ambiguous cases both relevant documents/pages must be cited.
metrics.abstention_accuracy: Unanswerable cases require an explicit abstention and no invented value. Ambiguous cases require the ambiguity to be surfaced without selecting one unsupported single answer.
metrics.paraphrase_consistency: Cases sharing a paraphrase_group must preserve the same factual answer and citation regardless of language or wording.
metrics.negation_accuracy: Negative questions must preserve the polarity of the cited source rule.
metrics.collision_handling: When two agreements provide potentially overlapping deadlines and the corpus contains no precedence rule, identify both terms and state that the corpus does not establish which single term controls.
